generatedFrom.inspectionMode: PE metadata, imports, resources where available, and ASCII/UTF-16 strings only. No execution and no decompilation.
generatedFrom.decompileStatus: blocked: no safe local decompiler was available and the user allowed metadata/strings inspection only in that case.

backendStatusDefinitions.implemented-live: Confirmed backend execution exists and is paired with rollback or backup metadata plus validation evidence.
backendStatusDefinitions.preview-only: Backend can inventory, classify, or produce a dry-run plan, but does not apply the change.
backendStatusDefinitions.catalog-only: Backend has static catalog/sample knowledge only; no live inventory or apply path.
backendStatusDefinitions.missing: No equivalent backend capability exists yet.
backendStatusDefinitions.unsafe: Source action is destructive or security-sensitive and must not be implemented without a dedicated safety design.
backendStatusDefinitions.blocked: Capability cannot be safely mapped from source-only inspection, usually because Dash internals were not decompiled or third-party installers/binaries are opaque.

capabilities.title: Competitive Mode game process priority, I/O priority, and CPU affinity controls
capabilities.summary: Competitive mode covers game selection, game CPU and I/O priority, CPU sets, and affinity presets that turn off SMT, the second CCD, or efficiency cores.

rollbackOrBackupRules: Game Tune and persistent policy sessions write backup manifests before confirmed process-control changes.
Stop-GameTuneSession.ps1 restores priority, affinity, I/O priority, and GPU priority from backup.
Stop-ProcessPolicySession.ps1 restores persistent process policy controls from backup.
Stop-ProcessGovernorSession.ps1 restores governor restraints from backup.

capabilities.notes: Backend implementation is independent and does not execute {source}.exe.

capabilities.title: Lower other processes and govern background CPU contention
capabilities.summary: Lowers the CPU priority of other running processes so more is left for the game.

rollbackOrBackupRules: Game Tune and persistent policy sessions write backup manifests before confirmed process-control changes.
Stop-GameTuneSession.ps1 restores priority, affinity, I/O priority, and GPU priority from backup.
Stop-ProcessPolicySession.ps1 restores persistent process policy controls from backup.
Stop-ProcessGovernorSession.ps1 restores governor restraints from backup.

capabilities.notes: Maps to process governor and persistent process policy backends, not to Dash execution.

capabilities.title: Clear standby memory for memory-heavy game stutter
capabilities.summary: Clears the Windows standby memory list to free RAM and reduce stutter in memory-heavy games.

rollbackOrBackupRules: Standby memory clear has an owned helper source/build/elevation plan; the transient purge remains product approval-gated because it cannot be restored.

capabilities.notes: Backend now exposes memory-pressure preview evidence plus a helper build/elevation plan; real standby-list clearing is product approval-gated.

capabilities.title: DirectX/NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Steam shader cache cleanup
capabilities.summary: Clears DirectX, NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Steam per-game shader caches so games rebuild shaders on next launch.

rollbackOrBackupRules: Real shader-cache cleanup is approval-gated and uses the controlled real-path planning plus backup/delete/restore contract.
Disposable fixture cleanup writes a backup manifest and can be restored by Restore-StutterOptimization.ps1.

capabilities.notes: Backend has preview, real-path planning, and disposable-fixture backup/delete/restore proof; real user-cache deletion is product approval-gated.

capabilities.title: Temporarily pause non-essential services while gaming
capabilities.summary: Pauses non-essential services and offers service start, stop and restart controls.

rollbackOrBackupRules: Service pause has controlled status/dependency analysis and shim-validated backup/pause/restore sequencing; real service control is approval-gated by exact service allowlist.

capabilities.notes: Backend exposes service pause candidates only; no service control command is called.

capabilities.title: Network latency, TCP, offload, throttling, Nagle, LLMNR, NetBIOS, and adapter toggles
capabilities.summary: Reduces network latency under load and offers network adapter toggles.
capabilities.notes: Hardware/adapter-specific changes need snapshot and rollback before implementation.

capabilities.title: Power plan switcher and high-performance power-state pinning
capabilities.summary: Selects and applies power plans, including bundled community plans, and keeps the chosen power state.

rollbackOrBackupRules: Controlled temporary power-plan export/import/select/restore/delete is implemented; preview captures active scheme restore requirements and product apply remains approval-gated.

capabilities.notes: Backend exposes active-plan restore requirements and a controlled temporary import/selection/restore/delete executor; product apply remains approval-gated.

capabilities.title: Large Windows tweak/toggle library
capabilities.summary: Windows toggles spanning Hyper-V, UAC, Game Mode, Game Bar, HAGS, fullscreen optimizations, timer resolution, memory compression, telemetry, activity history, animations, transparency and more.
capabilities.notes: Treat each toggle as unimplemented until there is a script, backup/rollback rule, and validation evidence.

capabilities.title: Global timer resolution toggle
capabilities.summary: A global timer resolution toggle; the playbook also bundles a timer-resolution helper and its setup script.

rollbackOrBackupRules: Timer apply is blocked until an owned lifecycle and stop/cleanup path are implemented.

capabilities.notes: Backend exposes timer-resolution status contract; no timer helper is launched.

capabilities.title: Installed app uninstaller and leftover review
capabilities.summary: Uninstalls apps, reviews leftovers, and removes preinstalled Microsoft Store apps.

rollbackOrBackupRules: New-CleanupDeletionManifest.ps1 emits preview-only backup requirements for files, registry exports, services, scheduled tasks, and startup entries.
backend/uninstall/uninstall-policy.json marks official uninstall and cleanup deletion as preview-only.

capabilities.notes: Backend intentionally previews only; it does not uninstall or delete leftovers.

capabilities.title: Restore removed UWP/Microsoft Store apps
capabilities.notes: No backend package restore/reinstall workflow exists.

capabilities.title: Dash profile import/export and app settings
capabilities.summary: Imports and exports settings profiles, resets app settings, opens the log folder, sets autostart, and re-checks playbook state.
capabilities.notes: Dash app behavior is separate from OS optimization backend; no Dash settings backend is in scope.

capabilities.title: System restore, downloads, updates, links, and app lifecycle
capabilities.summary: Turns System Restore on or off, creates restore points, and handles update downloads and tray behavior.
capabilities.notes: No backend restore-point lifecycle or app update downloader exists.
